name: vscode-sql-beautify
description: More Powerful extension that beautifies SQL/一键美化你的SQL

extension.uppercase.description: Convert keywords to uppercase/将关键词转变为大写

extension.comma_location.description: Fix the comma location to the end of the line/把逗号放在字段后面(不建议开启)

extension.bracket_char.description: Use whitespace to replace Tab in the indentation of subquery  /在子查询缩进场景中，把制表符替换成四个空格

extension.as_loc_cnt.description: Set max length of the column to align words after `as` and trailing comments  /自定义当你的字段长度超过多少字符，不参加as和行尾注释对齐(有AS时按AS前代码长度计算)

extension.case_when_then_wrap_length.description: Wrap all THEN/ELSE values in a CASE block when any WHEN condition or THEN value exceeds this length  /当 CASE 中任一 WHEN 条件或 THEN 结果超过该长度时，将整段 THEN/ELSE 值换到下一行

extension.keywordCase.description: Keyword case for formatted SQL. Explicit values override extension.uppercase. /格式化后的 SQL 关键词大小写；显式配置后优先于 extension.uppercase

extension.commaStyle.description: Comma placement style. Explicit values override extension.comma_location. /逗号位置风格；显式配置后优先于 extension.comma_location

extension.indentStyle.description: Indentation style for formatted SQL. Explicit values override extension.bracket_char. /格式化缩进风格；显式配置后优先于 extension.bracket_char

extension.maxAlignWidth.description: Maximum code width for AS and trailing comment alignment. Explicit values override extension.as_loc_cnt. /AS 和行尾注释对齐的最大代码宽度；显式配置后优先于 extension.as_loc_cnt

sqlBeautify.keywordCase.description: Keyword case for formatted SQL. /格式化后的 SQL 关键词大小写

sqlBeautify.commaStyle.description: Comma placement style. /逗号位置风格

sqlBeautify.indentStyle.description: Indentation style for formatted SQL. /格式化缩进风格

sqlBeautify.maxAlignWidth.description: Maximum code width for AS and trailing comment alignment. /AS 和行尾注释对齐的最大代码宽度

sqlBeautify.caseWhenThenWrapLength.description: Wrap threshold for CASE WHEN THEN and ELSE values. /CASE WHEN 中 THEN 和 ELSE 值的换行阈值

sqlBeautify.dialect.description: Best-effort SQL dialect boundary handling. Hive remains the primary formatting target. /SQL 方言边界处理；Hive 仍是主要格式化目标
